description: Recent headlines on Saudi and GCC energy (renewables, storage, hydrogen, power, oil and gas, water, data-centre power), gathered every three hours from publishers’ own feeds and the GDELT Project: the headline, its link, the publisher’s domain, the date and the language only. Filter by a tracked project id or a company slug; a headline is tagged only when it names the project or company unambiguously. Headlines belong to their publishers: cite the link, and do not treat a headline as a verified fact.
name: news_mentions
title: Headlines naming a project or company
